anomalies.description: At least two individuals are engaged in direct physical combat near the center of the alley: one person appears to be striking or grappling with another who is on or near the ground, while others surround them aggressively.

A large group of people is densely gathered along a narrow alleyway and over a low wall, actively pushing, climbing, and moving in a chaotic, agitated manner; some individuals are seen throwing objects or engaging in physical scuffles with others near the wall and doorway, consistent with a violent group clash.

A large crowd of people is densely packed on a raised platform or balcony, actively pushing and surging against a low wall; multiple individuals are seen climbing over or falling from the wall into the area below, indicating chaotic, violent group behavior consistent with a riot.

Two individuals are clearly locked in mutual physical combat near the low wall: one is bent over while the other appears to be punching or pulling them, with surrounding crowd pressing in; this is distinct from general crowd movement.

A large, densely packed crowd on an elevated platform or balcony is actively pushing and shoving, with multiple individuals being forced over the edge and falling to the ground below. The behavior is chaotic, collective, and violent, involving coordinated pressure and physical displacement of people, consistent with a riot or stampede in a confined space.

At least one individual (visible in f1–f4) is seen being actively pushed or thrown over the railing by others in the crowd, falling helplessly without resistance—indicating targeted violence against a vulnerable person during the broader unrest.

Multiple close-contact physical struggles occur within the crowd on the platform (e.g., f2–f6), including grabbing, pulling, and striking motions among individuals, indicating mutual combat amid the chaos.

A large, densely packed crowd surges violently at a narrow doorway and railing of a building, with individuals climbing over the railing and being pushed or falling into the open area below; the movement is chaotic, forceful, and non-peaceful, indicating collective violent unrest.; A large, densely packed crowd surges violently at a narrow entrance/exit with metal railings, leading to multiple individuals being pushed, trampled, and thrown over a low wall or ledge in a chaotic, uncontrolled manner. The movement is collective, forceful, and results in people falling and being carried along by the momentum of the group, consistent with a riotous stampede or violent crowd crush.

Within the surging crowd near the entrance (frames f0–f7), individuals are seen actively shoving, grabbing, and physically struggling against each other in close quarters, indicating mutual physical combat amid the larger chaos.

A large, densely packed crowd surges violently on a narrow elevated walkway and adjacent slope, with multiple individuals being pushed, falling, and tumbling down the embankment in a chaotic, uncontrolled manner. The movement is not orderly; people are seen flailing, being carried by the momentum, and colliding—indicative of a stampede or violent crowd collapse rather than a peaceful gathering.; A large, densely packed crowd surges against a railing on an elevated platform, with individuals climbing over and falling down the wall; chaotic movement and physical struggle indicate violent unrest.

After individuals fall over the ledge (starting frame f8), some on the ground appear immobilized while others in the crowd continue to push or step over them, suggesting attacks on helpless victims during the collapse phase.; At least one individual (e.g., person in red shirt at f3–f4) is seen on the ground while others stand over or move past them in a manner suggesting vulnerability and lack of agency; another person appears to be struck or shoved while already low to the ground (f4). Though context is limited, the posture and surrounding motion suggest targeted aggression toward a non-resisting person.

In the initial frames, several individuals engage in close physical struggles: one person in white is lifted and thrown (f0–f1); others grapple and push aggressively near the railing (f2–f4), with visible mutual combat including grabbing, shoving, and attempts to overpower. This appears distinct from the broader crowd surge and involves direct interpersonal violence.

A large group of people is engaged in violent unrest, including climbing over barriers, pushing against a railing, and confronting individuals in blue helmets (likely security forces). The scene shows chaotic movement, physical struggle, and attempts to breach a structure, consistent with a riot.

Two individuals are engaged in direct physical combat near the wall: one person in dark clothing is seen jumping onto or striking another person below who is being held or supported by others; visible grappling and aggressive motion.; Multiple individuals are seen physically grappling on the ground and against a wall; one person in dark clothing appears to be striking or restraining another while others intervene or assist in the scuffle.; Multiple individuals in the crowd engage in direct physical combat with uniformed personnel and among themselves near the railing: grappling, pulling, and striking are visible in close proximity. In frames f2–f15, at least two distinct pairs show mutual physical engagement (e.g., person in red shirt vs. helmeted officer; others wrestling over the barrier), satisfying the definition of mutual combat.

In frames f8–f9, a person in dark clothing is seen standing over a prone individual on the ground, appearing to strike or press down on them while others are nearby but not intervening immediately—suggesting an attack on a helpless victim.

A large crowd of civilians is densely packed against a low wall and railing, pushing and surging toward a group of uniformed personnel (wearing blue helmets) who are positioned on the other side, appearing to hold a line. The interaction involves physical contact, shoving, and attempts by individuals—including one in a red shirt climbing the wall—to breach the barrier. The scene shows sustained collective unrest with violent group dynamics, not merely a static crowd.
